name: soxoa
description: Choose a recurring workflow, estimate its illustrative capacity savings from your assumptions, and turn it into a practical pilot. Get a step-by-step workflow, a ready-to-use prompt, human review gates and acceptance checks using your current systems. Plans use supplied facts; tools do not connect your systems, deploy automation or measure actual savings.
